metrics.label: 1 − LPIPS
metrics.name: Perceptual similarity
metrics.description: AlexNet LPIPS distance converted to similarity: clip(1 − distance, 0, 1). Higher is better.

metrics.label: Object
metrics.name: Object accuracy
metrics.description: Checks object categories, counts, appearance, and initial layout.

metrics.label: Event
metrics.name: Event completion
metrics.description: Checks events, temporal order, and final states with three votes per item.

metrics.label: Motion
metrics.name: Motion overlap
metrics.description: Combines spatial and weighted IoU for motion regions and duration.

metrics.label: Validity
metrics.name: Physical validity
metrics.description: Inspects code and native states with task-specific probes and controlled interventions.
